paragraphs: Rav Malkhiyu: R. Adda bar Ahavah said that R. Malkhiyu said, Beitzah 28b. R. Malkhiyu said that R. Adda bar Ahavah said, Ketubbot 61b. Rabbah (Rava) said, 'Who is as wise as Rav Malkhiyu, for he is a great man?' Yevamot 113a. She'erit Yosef writes that he was Rav's student. He erred, for he appears to have lived in Rava's time.
